summary: Plaintiffs first raised attorneys’ fees in their opening term sheets, before class relief was settled, and fee and class-fund amounts were negotiated together within total-outlay constraints. Class counsel’s private reasoning considered firm economics, but the transcript does not clearly show counsel knowingly sacrificing class recovery in exchange for higher fees. Defense compared competing counsel’s totals and sought lower-cost settlement options, supporting reverse-auction tactics, but the final declaration accurately disclosed that fees and class relief were negotiated together.
